scheme_name: National Scheme Of Incentive To Girls For Secondary Education
other_conditions: must have passed class 8th from Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas
must be enrolled for class 9th in State/UT Government, Government‑aided, or local body schools from academic year 2008‑09 onwards
benefits_summary: A one‑time deposit of ₹3000 in a term/fixed deposit for each eligible girl, locked until she turns 18 years old.
